visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male creator with long dark hair is depicted as a floating cutout over a background of shiny black pearls in a pink bowl. He holds a small bowl and silver spoon, looking directly at the camera under bright studio lighting. He appears animated and engages the viewer immediately. (2) The scene transitions to the man seated in a domestic room at a wooden table. He is dressed in a dark button-up shirt. In front of him is a white paper takeout container filled with taro balls and liquid. He gestures towards the food with an inquisitive expression. (3) A close-up shot reveals the texture of the dessert: vibrant yellow sweet potato balls and pale purple taro balls submerged in a brownish syrup. A spoon dips into the mixture, highlighting the individual pieces which appear firm and distinct from one another. (4) The man takes a bite and his facial expression immediately turns to one of discomfort and struggle, eyes squinted and mouth turned down. To emphasize the stony hardness of the food, blue digital teardrop overlays are added to his cheeks. (5) In a sequence of quick cuts, the man uses a silver spoon to carefully scoop the solid taro and sweet potato balls out of the original takeout bowl and places them into a small pink ceramic bowl, separating them from the bulk of the syrup. (6) The man stands next to a black microwave oven in what appears to be a kitchen. He points a finger at the microwave's digital display panel, which clearly shows the time 00:59 and power level settings under warm, artificial lighting. (7) After microwaving, the man tastes a taro ball from the pink bowl. His facial expression transforms into one of genuine surprise and joy, with wide eyes and a slight smile. He holds the bowl close, appearing very satisfied with the new soft texture. (8) The video concludes with a medium shot of the man holding the original takeout container and its lid. He points toward the camera with a friendly, encouraging smile, using hand gestures to emphasize his recommendation to the audience.
